decisive_items: Revealed a focal scleral ectasia with no overlying retina
The sclera was approximately one-third thinner
response.rationale: The OCT directly demonstrates a focal scleral ectasia with thinning and absent overlying retina, which is the defining lesion. High myopia is a predisposing background but not the specific diagnosis.

rejected.why: Only provides background of high myopia and axial length, lacking the specific ectatic lesion description.
